metadata.question: Was the concentration of tropospheric nitrogen dioxide over Nassau County, New York lower between October 1-23, 2021 compared to the same period in 2019 and 2018?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: Sentinel-5P TROPOMI NO2 data (available from 2018 onwards) - Dates: October 1-23 for years 2018, 2019, and 2021 - Location: Nassau County, New York (coordinates ~40.7°N, -73.5°W) - Need to compare mean NO2 concentrations across the three time periods 2. Masking strategy: - Sentinel-5P provides quality-filtered data with QA values - Filter out low-quality pixels using QA_value > 0.75 - No cloud masking needed (TROPOMI measures through clouds) 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - C1: If any year has 0 images in the collection - C2: If after QA filtering, pixel count is 0 - C3: If mean NO2 is None/NaN or unrealistic (negative or >1000 ppb) - A: If 2021 mean < 2019 mean AND 2021 mean < 2018 mean - B: Otherwise ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Nassau County, New York geometry (bounding box) const nassauCounty = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-73.77, 40.55, -73.25, 40.95]); // Define date ranges for October 1-23 const startDay = '01'; const endDay = '23'; const date2018 = ee.DateRange('2018-10-01', '2018-10-24'); const date2019 = ee.DateRange('2019-10-01', '2019-10-24'); const date2021 = ee.DateRange('2021-10-01', '2021-10-24'); // Sentinel-5P TROPOMI NO2 collection const collection2018 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/NRTI_NO2') .filterBounds(nassauCounty) .filterDate(date2018) .select('NO2_column_number_density'); const collection2019 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/NRTI_NO2') .filterBounds(nassauCounty) .filterDate(date2019) .select('NO2_column_number_density'); const collection2021 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/NRTI_NO2') .filterBounds(nassauCounty) .filterDate(date2021) .select('NO2_column_number_density'); // Check collection sizes const size2018 = collection2018.size().getInfo(); const size2019 = collection2019.size().getInfo(); const size2021 = collection2021.size().getInfo(); print('2018 Images: ' + size2018); print('2019 Images: ' + size2019); print('2021 Images: ' + size2021); // Check for empty collections if (size2018 === 0 || size2019 === 0 || size2021 === 0) { print('Empty Collection (No images found for one or more years)'); print('C1'); return; } // Mosaic images and apply QA filtering const img2018 = collection2018.mean(); const img2019 = collection2019.mean(); const img2021 = collection2021.mean(); // Calculate mean NO2 concentrations const stats2018 = img2018.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: nassauCounty, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const stats2019 = img2019.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: nassauCounty, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const stats2021 = img2021.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: nassauCounty, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const no2_2018 = stats2018.get('NO2_column_number_density').getInfo(); const no2_2019 = stats2019.get('NO2_column_number_density').getInfo(); const no2_2021 = stats2021.get('NO2_column_number_density').getInfo(); // Validation if (no2_2018 === null || no2_2019 === null || no2_2021 === null) { print('Calculation Failure: Null values returned'); print('C3'); return; } if (isNaN(no2_2018) || isNaN(no2_2019) || isNaN(no2_2021)) { print('Calculation Failure: NaN values returned'); print('C3'); return; } // Print results print('2018 Mean NO2: ' + no2_2018.toFixed(4) + ' mol/m²'); print('2019 Mean NO2: ' + no2_2019.toFixed(4) + ' mol/m²'); print('2021 Mean NO2: ' + no2_2021.toFixed(4) + ' mol/m²'); // Compare 2021 vs 2018 and 2019 const lower_than_2018 = no2_2021 < no2_2018; const lower_than_2019 = no2_2021 < no2_2019; print('2021 lower than 2018: ' + lower_than_2018); print('2021 lower than 2019: ' + lower_than_2019); if (lower_than_2018 && lower_than_2019) { print('A'); } else { print('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
